name: Pink Floyd

whyMatters.en: London band that moved from Syd Barrett psychedelia to Waters/Gilmour concept albums; Dark Side (1973) and The Wall (1979) set album-length production as mass rock.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队：从 Syd Barrett 迷幻走到 Waters/Gilmour 概念专集；Dark Side（1973）与 The Wall（1979）把专辑时长制作做成大众摇滚。

note.zh: 钟声效果 + 专辑中脊动态（Time）。

note.en: Dual vocal/solo ballad from The Wall.
note.zh: The Wall 的双人声/独奏谣曲。

interviewQuotes.text: The purpose of the music is to free people.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Roger Waters

interviewQuotes.text: It's not about being loud. It's about being there.
interviewQuotes.speaker: David Gilmour

lyricQuotes: The child is grown, the dream is gone
We're just two lost souls swimming in a fish bowl

shortBio.en: Gilmour / Waters progressive rock; Time and Comfortably Numb are twin poles.
shortBio.zh: Gilmour / Waters 的 progressive rock；Time 与 Comfortably Numb 是两极。

body.en:
Formed 1965. Barrett-era singles precede the Waters-led concept run: Dark Side of the Moon, Wish You Were Here, Animals, The Wall—studio effects, spoken samples, long-form song cycles.

Time (1973) and Comfortably Numb (1979) show clock-work arrangement and dual-vocal/solo architecture. Lineup versions (Barrett → Waters dominance → later Gilmour-led) are first-class.
body.zh:
1965 年组建。Barrett 时期单曲之后是 Waters 主导的概念专集序列：Dark Side of the Moon、Wish You Were Here、Animals、The Wall——录音室效果、口语采样、长歌曲组。

Time（1973）与 Comfortably Numb（1979）展示钟表式编曲与双人声/独奏架构。阵容版本（Barrett → Waters 主导 → 后期 Gilmour 主导）是一等对象。

body.en:
Floyd matter as proof that long-form production, sound design, and thematic albums can sit on mass charts without singles-only logic.

Studio and live spectacle share one engineering culture.
body.zh:
Floyd 要紧处是证明：长制作、声音设计与主题专辑可以上大众榜，而不只靠单曲逻辑。

录音室与现场奇观共享同一工程文化。

body.en:
Early psychedelia is Barrett-centered. Mid catalog is Waters writing + Gilmour guitar/vocal. Post-1985 Gilmour-led albums are another legal/musical chapter.

Versions explain disputes and sound shifts.
body.zh:
早期迷幻以 Barrett 为中心。中期目录是 Waters 写作 + Gilmour 吉他/人声。1985 后 Gilmour 主导专辑是另一法律/音乐章节。

版本解释争执与声音转向。

body.en:
Sound-effect intro, rototom figure, verse/chorus, Gilmour solo—Dark Side’s structural teaching track.

Production narrative without needing mystical language.
body.zh:
音效引入、rototom 音型、主副歌、Gilmour 独奏——Dark Side 的结构教材曲。

制作叙事无需神秘语言。

title.en: Comfortably Numb: dual vocal, dual solo

body.en:
Waters verse dryness against Gilmour chorus lift; two celebrated guitar solos in one song. The Wall’s mass-entry ballad.

Arrangement drama as rock theatre craft.
body.zh:
Waters 主歌干对 Gilmour 副歌抬升；一曲两段著名吉他独奏。The Wall 的大众入口谣曲。

编曲戏剧即摇滚剧场工艺。

title.en: Wright keys, Mason drums, Gilmour/Waters split
title.zh: Wright 键盘、Mason 鼓、Gilmour/Waters 分工

body.en:
Richard Wright’s harmony pads and Nick Mason’s steady drums underpin the concept years. Vocal and lyric authority shifts are audible across albums.

Listen for who writes the frame.
body.zh:
Richard Wright 的和声铺底与 Nick Mason 稳健鼓组支撑概念专集年代。人声与歌词权威的转移在各专可闻。

听谁在写框架。

title.zh: 无戏服金属的 prog 野心

body.en:
Later art-rock and ambient-adjacent bands cite the production; metal cites the scale. Punk often refuses the spectacle.

Catalog remains a studio-engineering reference.
body.zh:
后来 art-rock 与 ambient 邻近乐队引用其制作；金属引用其体量。朋克常拒绝其奇观。

目录仍是录音室工程参照。

note.zh: 以 Syd Barrett 为中心的迷幻版本。
概念专集巅峰 Waters/Gilmour 搭档。

note.en: Concept-album production as mass-rock default ambition.
note.zh: 概念专集制作成为大众摇滚默认野心。
